niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, audience, markets, creative needs and whether you want programmatic scale, direct-sold premium inventory, or performance-driven response. Below is a short guide to help you choose plus recommended partners by use case.

Top agencies/platforms by use case
- Large global/full-service (best if you want full media + creative + measurement and big premium reach): GroupM (Mindshare/Wavemaker), Omnicom (OMD/Hearts & Science), Publicis (Starcom/Zenith), IPG (UM/Initiative), Dentsu (Carat).  
- Programmatic/advanced targeting & DSPs (best if you want audience-based buying and granular optimization): The Trade Desk, Magnite (incl. SpotX), Xandr/Microsoft Advertising, Roku OneView, Amobee.  
- CTV-specialist platforms and agencies (performance or TV-to-digital expertise): Simulmedia, VideoAmp, Cadent, MNTN (performance-focused CTV).  
- Measurement/attribution and creative tech (if measurement or dynamic creative is critical): Innovid, Samba TV, FreeWheel, TVSquared.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Objective: brand awareness, reach/frequency, sales/DR, or attribution measurement?  
- Targeting: broad demo vs narrow audience segments/households?  
- Inventory: premium publisher buys (streamers, MVPDs) vs programmatic open marketplace?  
- Measurement needs: cross-screen attribution, incremental lift studies, or last-touch reporting?  
- Creative: do you need 15–60s brand spots, interactive CTV creative, or dynamic product feeds?  
- Budget and markets: global vs local, large TV-scale budgets vs smaller pilot budgets.

If you want a quick recommendation
- For brand TV-scale reach + agency support: choose one of the big holding-group media agencies (Mindshare, OMD, Starcom, UM).  
- For advanced programmatic CTV buying: The Trade Desk or Roku OneView.  
- For performance-driven/direct-response CTV: MNTN or Simulmedia.

If you tell me your objective (brand vs performance), target audience, budget range and markets (US/global/local), I can recommend 2–3 agencies/platforms best suited to your campaign and why.
